title: Claude Agent SDK overview
summary: The Agent SDK runs Claude Code's agent loop as a Python or TypeScript library: built-in tools, hooks, subagents, MCP, permissions, sessions that resume or fork, skills, commands, memory and plugins loaded by path. A mod's hooks run under the SDK but nothing is drawn. Third-party products may not offer claude.ai login; they use API keys.
ideas: The orchestrator as a program over the records (avenCEO's later) could be an SDK program.
It is not an interface: no pane, and it needs an API key rather than Samuel's plan.

took.idea: Not now: the SDK is for a program, not the view
